turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me about the HVAC repair work you do in your current role.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: At Acme I repair rooftop HVAC units for commercial sites across West Yorkshire. I've been there since March 2023, and I do about twelve call-outs a week, every one logged in the CMMS.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When did you start doing that, and is it still part of your week?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: March 2023, and yes, repair work is still most of my week. Last quarter I closed 41 of my 46 call-outs on the first visit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, thank you. Let's move to the next one. Tell me about the last fault you traced from scratch and what came of it.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Last month I traced a recurring compressor trip across 6 rooftop units from scratch using the CMMS history and a leak detector, and wrote a three-step repair plan. It cleared five of the six.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How did you decide where to start looking?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I started with the units that had tripped in the last 60 days, because that pointed to a shared cause, and I ruled out anything under 5 years old because those were still under the maker's warranty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Which parts of that were yours, and which came from someone else?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The diagnosis and the repair plan were mine. My supervisor signed off the first parts order but the fault-finding and the fixes were my calls.
